Regression smoke passed: /events shows 12 cards, event detail renders reviews-average 4.67 · 6 reviews, admin dashboard tabs load, login works, no new console errors beyond the pre-existing pattern.

issues: Admin sub-tabs row (Dashboard/Users/Partners/Events/Payouts/Reviews) does not fit at 390px width — Payouts and Reviews are cut off with no visible horizontal scroll affordance. Users can still reach them via keyboard but discoverability is poor. Suggest a horizontally-scrollable tab strip or a mobile 'More' overflow.

action_items: Consider making the admin sub-tab bar horizontally scrollable at <420px so Payouts/Reviews remain visible on mobile (minor UX).

seed_past_events.py should optionally re-seed one un-answered foreign review + one already-flagged review for reproducible moderation demos — currently the demo starts with 0 flagged, which makes the admin Flagged filter look empty on a fresh reseed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2054 lines — reviews/moderation/pwa additions have pushed it further past the 700-line soft limit. Splitting into routers (reviews.py, admin.py, partner.py) will materially improve maintainability and test isolation.

reply_to_review expects body.get('body') but this key name shadows the FastAPI parameter name 'body: dict'. Consider renaming the JSON field to 'text' or 'reply_body' to avoid confusion (the frontend + backend both use 'body' consistently today so no behavioural bug, just readability).

moderate_review on action=publish resets flag_count to 0 unconditionally — if the review was flagged 3 times by 3 different reporters and only some resolved, the historical count is lost. Consider storing resolved_flag_count instead and preserving reports for audit (currently reports.status is updated to 'resolved' so audit trail exists, so this is minor).

sw.js correctly avoids caching /api/* except /api/files/, but uses caches.match(request) which is not scoped to a specific cache — cross-cache matches are fine here since we only have shell+media, but scoping to caches.open(cacheName).match() is safer if more caches are added.

InstallPrompt.jsx sets localStorage on close but never re-arms — after a user dismisses once they will never see the prompt again on that device, even months later. Consider expiring the dismissal after ~30 days.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iter-4 UI flows verified (PWA SW registered, report review + duplicate, admin moderation hide/restore/delete filters + stats, partner reply + public rendering, mobile 390px responsive)
